newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom slips in grey trade.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom slips in grey trade.

text.p: Shares in newly-floated Deutsche Telekom AG on Monday slipped slightly in unofficial "grey trade" ahead of the first official estimate of its early trading price, independent brokers said on Monday.
Frankfurt-based broker Schnigge & Partner said shares in grey market dealings were quoted around 31.50 and 32.50 marks at 1000 GMT, compared to a level of around 33 marks earlier in the day.
Brokerage group Instinet said it saw prices of around 31.60 marks to 31.45 being quoted, adding that volumes were increasing.
"We reckon that this means the share price will swing between 31 and 31.50 marks," said one Instinet broker.
Grey market trade is carried on by brokers between themselves without official controls. An official estimate of the trading price of Telekom shares is due around 1030 GMT.
